text.title: FreshDrop, buyer pays for an express slot
text.m5: 5a. service result to the screen on success
text.m6: 5b. reason to the screen on failure or silence
text.scope: One scenario: a buyer pays for a 2-hour express slot; starts at «Pay», ends at order confirmation
text.decision: Add a 3-second timeout with one retry on the payment call; confirm the result asynchronously from the bank
text.gaps: The 3-D Secure branch, the 5-minute slot hold and the courier notice are collapsed
